name: Anonymous Feedback
description: An anonymous feedback collection built with the Anonymous Feedback recipe.

intro.message:
Your responses are anonymous to the class.

Your teacher will see a summary, not who said what. Be honest!

ask.prompt: How is class going for you? What is working well, and what would help?

for-teacher.instruction: You are summarizing anonymous student feedback for the teacher's eyes only. Group similar responses into 3-5 themes. For each theme, give a short bold heading and a one or two sentence summary of what students said. Then a short list of things the teacher could try. Never quote a response word for word, and never describe what one student said: only patterns that several students share, so nobody in the room can be picked out. No names, no descriptions of a person. Keep the whole thing under 250 words. Bold headings only, no # headings, no italics.

for-class.instruction: You are writing what a class said, for the class to read together on the projector. Group the responses into 3-5 themes, each a short bold heading and one plain sentence starting with what the class said ("Many of us...", "Several people..."). Only patterns that several students share: never what one student said, never a quote, never a name or a description of a person. No advice to the teacher, no next steps, no thanks. Under 150 words. Bold headings only, no # headings, no italics.

end.message: Thanks for sharing, your feedback matters.

params.question: How is class going for you? What is working well, and what would help?
